name: Nationale-Nederlanden San Silvestre Vallecana
summary: Iconic 10K through the heart of Madrid every New Year's Eve, with around 40,000 runners starting on Avenida de Concha Espina by the Bernabéu, running down Calle de Serrano past the Puerta de Alcalá and Paseo del Prado, and finishing at the Estadio de Vallecas.
heroNote: Calle de Serrano and Paseo del Prado are wide and easy to access. The Puerta de Alcalá, the Atocha glorieta, and Avenida de la Albufera entering Vallecas are the loudest spectator zones.
specialNote: The Popular race uses multiple start waves spread across the late afternoon. The listed start time is for the first wave — your actual start may be later.
